_note: DMR commit-gate fault-tolerance contract example. One-hot single-bit-flip fault model (XOR with shifted mask). See README.md for the explicit list of what this DOES and DOES NOT verify.

signals.name: broadcast_valid_r
signals.note: External broadcast handshake — registered same cycle as commit_valid_r.

signals.name: corrupted_broadcast_r
signals.note: Observer: latches if broadcast_data_r ever disagrees with y_b_q while commit_valid_r is high. Safety property in observable form.

properties.description: Safety: the observer never latches a mismatch. Under the one-hot single-bit-flip fault model on y_a, commit_valid only asserts when y_a_post == y_b, so broadcast_data always equals the pipelined reference y_b_q.
Baseline: every reachable state has at least one outgoing transition.
